scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT
    billing_id,
    admission_id,
    CASE
        WHEN charge_type IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(charge_type AS VARCHAR(100)))) = ''
            THEN 'No Especificado'
        ELSE UPPER(LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(charge_type AS VARCHAR(100)))), 1))
             + LOWER(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(charge_type AS VARCHAR(100)))), 2, LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(charge_type AS VARCHAR(100)))))))
    END AS charge_type,
    CASE
        WHEN payment_status IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_status AS VARCHAR(100)))) = ''
            THEN 'No Especificado'
        ELSE UPPER(LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_status AS VARCHAR(100)))), 1))
             + LOWER(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_status AS VARCHAR(100)))), 2, LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_status AS VARCHAR(100)))))))
    END AS payment_status,
    TRY_CONVERT(
        DECIMAL(12, 2),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(
            REPLACE(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(
                        REPLACE(CAST(amount AS VARCHAR(60)), 'USD', ''),
                        '$', ''
                    ),
                    ',', ''
                ),
                CHAR(160), ''
            )
        ))
    ) AS amount,
    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 23),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 101),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 110),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 107),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), '-', ' '), 106),
        TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(payment_date AS VARCHAR(60)))) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
    ) AS payment_date
FROM bronze.billing
WHERE billing_id IS NOT NULL',
